description:
A synchronous natural-language query against a single SearchIndex. The synchronous shape (distinct from the async SearchIndexQuery used for structured lexical queries) is intentional: this request type exists to be called from the Bedrock agent's return-control loop and from low-latency UI affordances, both of which need a single round-trip from query text to ranked hits without polling.

For SEMANTIC and HYBRID modes, the manager translates queryText into one match sub-query per semantic-enriched column on the target SearchIndex (per the resolved SearchConfiguration's columnSemanticEnrichment list) — AOSS rewrites each such match into a neural sparse query under the hood. For HYBRID the lexical and semantic sub-queries are combined through OpenSearch's hybrid compound query with a normalization processor; the available normalization / combination techniques are constrained to the AOSS-documented values.

ACL scoping. The query is executed as the caller. Rows referencing entities the caller cannot READ are filtered out before being returned, matching the access-control behavior of SearchIndexQuery.

searchIndexId.description: Required. The Synapse ID of the SearchIndex entity to query. The caller must have READ access to this entity.

queryText.description: Required. The natural-language query. For SEMANTIC and HYBRID modes this string becomes the value of every match sub-query; AOSS handles the neural rewrite. For KEYWORD mode it is fed verbatim to a standard analyzed match query.

mode.description: Required. Which retrieval strategy to use. SEMANTIC and HYBRID require at least one semantic-enriched column on the target SearchIndex; if none exists the request is downgraded to KEYWORD and the downgrade is reflected on SemanticSearchResponse.mode.

topK.description: Optional. Maximum number of hits to return. Defaults to 10. Capped at 100 to keep latency and AOSS OCU spend bounded; callers needing larger result windows should fall back to SearchIndexQuery.

columnFilter.description: Optional. Restricts SEMANTIC and HYBRID retrieval to a subset of the semantic-enriched columns on the target SearchIndex. Each entry is a column name; columns named here but not enriched on the target SearchIndex are silently dropped. Omit to query every enriched column on the index.

hybridNormalization.description: Optional. Normalization technique used when mode is HYBRID. Allowed values per the AOSS docs: min_max, l2. Defaults to min_max. Ignored when mode is KEYWORD or SEMANTIC.

hybridCombination.description: Optional. Combination technique used when mode is HYBRID. Allowed values per the AOSS docs: arithmetic_mean, geometric_mean, harmonic_mean. Defaults to arithmetic_mean. Ignored when mode is KEYWORD or SEMANTIC.

hybridLexicalWeight.description: Optional. The weight assigned to the BM25 lexical sub-query when mode is HYBRID. The semantic sub-queries each receive (1 - hybridLexicalWeight) / N where N is the number of enriched columns under retrieval. Defaults to 0.3. Must be in the [0.0, 1.0] range. Ignored when mode is KEYWORD or SEMANTIC.
